name: browser-use
headline: Fulling - AI Full-Stack Development Automation
short_description: Fulling is an AI-powered full-stack engineer agent that automates web development. It uses Next.js, Claude, shadcn/ui, and PostgreSQL. It deploys on Kubernetes. It benefits developers and operations teams by accelerating development and deployment workflows.
author: FullAgent

sections.overview:
Fulling is an AI-powered full-stack engineer agent designed to automate web development workflows. It leverages Next.js, Claude, shadcn/ui, and PostgreSQL to streamline the entire development pipeline from coding to deployment. The agent handles both development and deployment tasks, with built-in support for Kubernetes orchestration. It benefits development teams by accelerating project delivery and reducing manual engineering overhead. Operations teams gain improved deployment consistency and automated infrastructure management.
Quickly set up a full-stack application with Next.js and PostgreSQL in minutes.
Deploy applications to a Kubernetes cluster without dealing with complex YAML configurations.
Utilize Claude Code to automate repetitive coding tasks and enhance development efficiency.
Manage project configurations and OAuth settings directly through the user interface.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/FullAgent/fulling`
sections.usage:
```
Create a full-stack web application for [PROJECT_NAME] using Next.js, shadcn/ui, and PostgreSQL. The app should have [FEATURES]. Deploy the application on Kubernetes. Ensure the deployment includes [SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENTS].
```
Copy

```
The AI has successfully created a full-stack web application for a project named 'TaskMaster'. The application includes features such as user authentication, task creation, and task assignment. The frontend is built with Next.js and shadcn/ui, providing a modern and responsive interface. The backend is powered by PostgreSQL, ensuring efficient data management. The application is deployed on Kubernetes, with a scalable and robust infrastructure. The deployment includes CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and logging, ensuring seamless operation and quick troubleshooting. The AI has also provided detailed documentation on how to use and maintain the application.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
